title: Synthesis and advanced applications of MXene nanosheets in energy storage, EMI shielding, and biomedicine: a review

MXene nanosheets are 2D transition metal carbides/nitrides with tunable surfaces, used in energy storage, EMI shielding, and biomedical applications due to their high conductivity, electrochemical performance, and biocompatibility.
